inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: Pediatric CPR training expired for primary caregiver on 12/29/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three out of four children did not have the required admission information on file during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: Four out of four children did not have the required physicians health statement available fore review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure: 2 prohibited structures were observed in the playground accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure (26 TAC §747.4403(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The caregiver was missing 16 of the required 30 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: Pediatric first aid training expired for the caregiver on 12/29/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The Primary Caregiver was lacking 22 of the required 30 annual training hours. The caregiver had 8 out of 30 training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not have for review documented fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year: No lock down drills were conducted during the 2021 calendar year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: The emergency contact address for a child enrolled was not listed on the admission form.    This was corrected at inspection when the director called the emergency contact and obtained the address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The most recent Children Product Safety Certification was dated 1/6/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: A statement of good health was not available at the time of inspection for 2 dogs in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: A play yard used for an infant in care did not have a snug fitting sheet at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during evaluation or probation: Conditions of probation were evaluated today and not all conditions were met.    One of 2 children records reviewed today was still missing the emergency contact address.  The state form reflected the record had been reviewed and was compliant.      This was corrected at inspection when the emergency contact address was obtained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: A play yard used for an infant in care did not have a snug fitting sheet at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Medication bottles were located on the dining table which was accessible to children.    This was corrected at inspection when the medication was moved to an area inaccessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3607(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: The emergency contact address for a child enrolled was not listed on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during evaluation or probation: Conditions of probation were evaluated today and not all conditions were met.    One of 2 children records reviewed today was missing the emergency contact address.  The state form reflected the record had been reviewed and was compliant.  A plan was put in place to ensure records were compliant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children: The first aid kit was stored below the diaper changing table which in a location accessible to children in care.    This was corrected at inspection when the first aid kit was moved to an area inaccessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3801(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook provided at the time of inspection did not include information regarding the promotion of physical activity including: (A) The duration of physical activity at your home, both indoor and outdoor; (B) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and (C) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The parent handbook provided at the time of inspection did not include information regarding animals at the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §747.501(7))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during evaluation or probation: Conditions of probation were evaluated today and not all conditions were met.    The daily maintenance checklist form was last updated on 10/29/21.    The daily infant nap form was last updated on 10/29/21.    The remainder of the conditions were met.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)
